mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscription (endpoint, p256dh, auth, user_id) VALUES (#{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE SET p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh, auth = EXCLUDED.auth, user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, push_subscription.user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM push_subscription ORDER BY added_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM push_subscription WHERE last_delivered_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE push_subscription SET last_delivered_at = #{now} WHERE endpoint = #{endpoint}
UPDATE push_subscription SET last_sent_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
